feeds.title: Jamila Kyari Blog
feeds.description: JamilaKyari.com is an African fashion and lifestyle brand that inspires women to live a colourful, vibrant and bold life. It achieves this through the showcase of bright colours, vibrant prints and bold patterns in women's apparel, home decor, stationery and gifts. Content includes style posts, product reviews and lifestyle tips tricks with an African twist.

feeds.title: Fashion Breed
feeds.description: A fashion blog from South Africa, regularly updated with photo-stories, everyday style, travel, events and articles. The site has witnessed its growth since its founding early in 2010 and documents the way Aqeelah has incorporated fashion in her many adventures.

feeds.title: African fashion Blog
feeds.description: This is all aimed at emphasizing to the region that fashion is an income generating creative industry, meanwhile promoting the 'Made in Africa' concept.

feeds.title: King Sidney Blog
feeds.description: Discover Afica's finest wearable art in the form of these unparalleled dinner jackets, designer tuxedos & statement blazers for men in Nairobi and Kenya.

feeds.title: Fashion Ghana
feeds.description: Get All The Latest Updates In Trends, Style & the African Fashion Industry. FashionGHANA is the world's most popular African fashion magazine for creatives & trends according to websiteoutlook.com. For over a decade we have been a window into the exciting creativity on the continent, from cultural aesthetics to popular modern chic styles.

feeds.title: Svelte Magazine
feeds.description: Covers the best style and beauty tips to help you dress and look better. Svelte Magazine is the top fashion ezine that aims to be the mirror you look into to get a reflection of fashion and style in Africa. With news, articles and other content revolving around the business of fashion, we hope to be the first and last resort of every fashion enthusiast.

feeds.title: Brett Robson
feeds.description: Fashion by Brett Robson was started in 2010 when Brett found herself unemployed. Fashion by Brett Robson has worked with many brands, been featured in multiple publications and continues to grow & enrich both existing & new brand relations.

feeds.title: Arum Lilea
feeds.description: Arum Lilea was born in 2011 with the intention of inspiring young women to live their best lives possible. Focusing on the personal style and elegance that everyone can add to their daily attire. Whether being in a corporate environment or casual university style, Arum Lilea aims to offer something to everyone and make stylish living attainable for each and every lady

feeds.title: Baked Online
feeds.description: Baked Online a publishing platform highlighting beauty and fashion trends in South Africa and the world. Founded in 2009 by Aisha Baker - Parnell, Baked The Blog has grown with its creator to become an award winning blog

feeds.title: Style Africa Fashion Network
feeds.description: I'm Roshan Isaacs; ex Broadcast Media Mogul turned Fashion Fabulous Extraodinnaire and founder of Style Africa. I created this platform by Africans, for Africans, to celebrate the vast pool of talent within Africa - from established, well-known designers, to up-and-coming young talents. Here you won't only find Creatives from within the design and textile sphere, but also local artists from the music, tv, and film industries.

feeds.title: casualimagedesigns
feeds.description: Follow my blog to get new content delivered directly to your inbox.

feeds.title: ALLEON
feeds.description: ALLEON is fashion label that reflects today's multicultural society by interpreting diverse cultural heritages of Western and African countries and transfers it into new fashion trends and styles. These fashion items perfectly blend in the richness of African textiles into contemporary western fashion trends. This unique mixture of traditional African high quality wax fabrics or african prints and the latest international trends symbolizes the cultural mix in today's society.

feeds.title: African Prints in Fashion
feeds.description: Follow the African Prints in Fashion Blog for your dose of contemporary African fashion trends, outfit ideas, the latest designs and designer interviews.

feeds.title: Style Me Blog
feeds.description: Style Me is a Durban based image consulting & personal stylist business designed to enhance your best features & disguise the ones you are less proud of. Daniyel Berry, is a qualified Fashion Designer who has channeled her passion into building self-confidence in her clients through Image Consulting.

feeds.title: iStyleBlaq
feeds.description: iStyleBlaq is an African blog that celebrates and promotes black excellence from the beauty and fashion space, and other sectors giving the message we can in a world dominated by western ideas.
